what: One canvas pinned behind the screen holds a single black glossy metal sculpture, and for each section the shape (ring, half-circle C, rounded bar, glasses), position, size and bumps are scrubbed (following .48s late) from data-from → data-to while that section passes through the screen — it reflects three long light panels in a dark room so white lines run along the edges, always rotates slowly at .06 rad per second and tilts .12 rad toward the cursor over 1.2s power3.out. Suited to a black portfolio that places one sculpture behind and beside big type and changes it to a different form at each section turn

options.scrub: Seconds of lag when following scroll, default .48
options.spin: Auto-rotation speed (rad/s), default .06 — 0 means no rotation (when the ring faces front)
options.sway: Idle breathing — sways by this much (rad) with vertical-axis sin(.5t) and horizontal-axis sin(.37t)×½, and floats up by sin(.6t)×.3, default 0
options.enter: A shape that starts at a slant (.18 on the horizontal axis · −.5 rad on the vertical) settles into pose with expo.out over this many seconds, default 0 (none) — on the original work list’s first screen the bars stand in a little over 1 second and subtly settle down until 5.5s (enter 6)

parts.stage: data-shape(ring·arc·bar·glasses) · data-from / data-to 「x: .3; y: -.1; s: 1.2; rx: .4; ry: 0; rz: 0; o: 1” (x · y are ratios of half the screen width and height, s size, r* rad, o opacity) · for phones data-mfrom · data-mto · data-start · data-end (ScrollTrigger form, default top center → bottom center — keep them from overlapping neighboring sections) · data-ease · when leaving the section the shape disappears (with data-keep it stays in its end shape) · with data-front the canvas rises above the text during that section so the shape covers the letters

note: Shape color is --fx-metal (default --kf-bg), reflected light is --fx-light (default --kf-ink). The original draws the glasses from a model file (glb) with the rings and logo in custom shaders. Here the same silhouette proportions are matched with three’s stock shapes (torus, partial torus, rounded box, two lenses and temples). The canvas is position: fixed, so it sits behind the screen wherever it is inside the panel (el)
use: <main data-fx="scroll-sculpture-gl"><section data-fx-part="stage" data-shape="ring" data-from="x: .4; s: .8" data-to="x: -.2; s: 1.2; ry: 1">…</section>…</main> — loads gsap · ScrollTrigger · coin-drop-physics/three-global.js · three.cjs first

from.where: First-section shapes on every page (glasses, ring, C, bar) — global-environment canvas
